sources.name: Rotten Tomatoes editorial, All Pixar Movies Ranked by Tomatometer (31 films, updated Sep 3 2026; page order used)
IMDb user ratings via Yahoo UK, Every Pixar film ranked (29 films, includes Elio; ties averaged; no Hoppers or Toy Story 5)
YouGov Ratings, Most Popular Pixar Movies in America (Q2 2026; only top 20 read, others scored as 25)
sources.method: continuous US poll, % positive opinion (popularity, so older and better-known films are favored)

sources.name: NPR Pop Culture Happy Hour listener vote (top 10 only; read via WAMC mirror of NPR story, others scored as 15)
sources.method: fan vote, 2,500+ votes, 3 picks each, 28 films

changes_vs_current: Top 11 is the same set as before but reshuffled (Toy Story 1, Nemo 2, Up 3, Toy Story 3 4, WALL-E 5; Inside Out falls from 2nd-5th to 8th, Coco rises to 11th). Cars moves up to 17th (YouGov popularity). Dropped: Elemental (it was 24th). Added: Cars 3. Toy Story 5, Hoppers and Elio (2025-26 releases) just miss (about 22.5 avg, rank 26-28) because the IMDb source predates them.
confidence: medium: 4 independent sources agree on the top 11, but the 12-24 band is noisy. YouGov is popularity, not quality (Cars is 5th there). NPR is top-10 only. Ranker (fan vote) could not be read (Cloudflare block). Toy Story 5 and Hoppers have 1 usable source each, so they are under-counted. RT page order has small oddities (Toy Story 4 listed at 96% above 97% films); page order was used as published.
